title: Post-trade slippage report
description: Written by analytics task 67aa802b. Compares decision-time signal price to actual fill price. Per the run-classification contract (config/run_classification.json), the top-level rows/summary cover SCHEDULED-live fills only; manual fills are confined to the separate manual_test_runs section and never affect scheduled-live metrics.

run_scope.description: The top-level rows/summary are scheduled-live only. Fixed to 'scheduled_live' to make the scope explicit.

scheduled_run_id.description: run_classification.run_id of the scheduled run these rows were derived from (scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET).

excluded_manual_order_ids.description: Order IDs collected from manual_runs/**/run_state*.json and excluded from the scheduled-live rows/summary.

used_broker_time_window_fallback.description: True only when a valid scheduled state existed but lacked order IDs due to a known write failure and in-window broker orders were attributed instead (manual IDs still excluded).

accepted_state_schema_versions.description: Scheduled run_state schema versions accepted for this report. Both run-classification-v1 and the stricter successor run-classification-v2-preauthorized are accepted when the required scheduled identity fields are correct.

source_order_history_payloads.description: Paths to persisted Robinhood order-history payloads (e.g. scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/raw/orders_after_place.json) used to compute average fill price / executions. Added 2026-07-10: the slippage task persists broker order-history responses before computation and computes fills from the saved payloads rather than re-querying the broker.

manual_test_runs.description: Clearly labeled 'Manual Test Runs' section. Manual fills are reported here only and never affect scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, or order-count metrics.
